questions.name: event_match
questions.instructions: Choose the event this report concerns. Shared protest vocabulary, one city, or proximity alone does not identify the same event. Explicit reposts should retain their existing event. Unknown time/location must not be guessed. Use only earlier candidate evidence.

choices.description: A relevant new incident, planned gathering, national/regional context, recovery, or an unlocated claim not linked to an existing event.
Unrelated ordinary social content or explicitly historical content with no useful existing event link.
Existing event; judge its supplied reports, time, place and claims.
